recommendation: The deterministic priority engine rated Kakinada Urban Slums, Coastal Industrial Park, and Machilipatnam Delta as moderate priority (scores 71, 68, 67) because each has high hazard severity (85, 85, 75), large exposed populations (8,500; 2,500; 4,200), and vulnerability scores above 70, with the only missing factor being immediate life risk.
